OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. Duplicate
            detection is now performed solely through the derived 'identityKey'
            (normalized telephone, email and household), so sharing a household no
            longer rejects a create on its own; this flag is never persisted or
            returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same
                last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace). Assigned when an owner is created and another owner
                already occupies that household; every owner in the household is
                given the same value. It forms the household component of the
                'identityKey'. Absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation.
                Starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved
                for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, taken from the REGION component of the
                owner's customerCode (the region derived from the postcode);
                'UNKNOWN' when no customer code or region is present.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
                equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
                is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
                telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+16085551023||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                flagged at creation as a possible duplicate of an existing owner
                because it shares that owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different normalized telephone. False when no such match exists.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.

          type: string

          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string

          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. Duplicate
            detection is now performed solely through the derived 'identityKey'
            (normalized telephone, email and household), so sharing a household no
            longer rejects a create on its own; this flag is never persisted or
            returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same
                last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace). Assigned when an owner is created and another owner
                already occupies that household; every owner in the household is
                given the same value. It forms the household component of the
                'identityKey'. Absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation.
                Starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved
                for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, taken from the REGION component of the
                owner's customerCode (the region derived from the postcode);
                'UNKNOWN' when no customer code or region is present.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
                equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
                is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
                telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+16085551023||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                flagged at creation as a possible duplicate of an existing owner
                because it shares that owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different normalized telephone. False when no such match exists.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. Duplicate
            detection is now performed solely through the derived 'identityKey'
            (normalized telephone, email and household), so sharing a household no
            longer rejects a create on its own; this flag is never persisted or
            returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the
                first twelve upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized last name (trimmed, collapsed whitespace, lower-cased)
                joined by '|' to the postcode. Owners sharing a last name and
                postcode therefore share the same value automatically. It forms the

## Summary

I made the `householdId` deterministic and rewired household duplicate detection in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`.

**Behavior changes implemented:**

1. **Deterministic householdId** — Now computed as the first 12 upper-case hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)`, where `normalizedLastName` is the trimmed/whitespace-collapsed/lower-cased last name. It's assigned to every owner that has a postcode; an owner with no postcode has no household (`householdId` stays null, so `identityKey` keeps its `+tel||` form).

2. **Household duplicate = same (lastName, postcode)** — Before persisting, the code checks whether any existing owner resolves to the same computed householdId. If so, the create is rejected with **409** unless the request sets `sharesHousehold`, in which case the owner is created as a declared household member.

3. **`sharesHousehold` only bypasses the block** — It no longer creates/propagates the link (the link is now automatic via the deterministic id); it just skips the 409. A declared member is explicitly **not** flagged as a possible duplicate (`possibleDuplicate=false`), rather than running the soft-match that would otherwise flag it since it shares last name + postcode.

4. **Duplicate detection keys off the computed householdId** — the `identityKey` check uses the deterministic value on both the new and existing owners.

**Files changed:**
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — replaced the old (lastName, address) household-matching block; added `computeHouseholdId(Owner)`; updated `householdId(...)` to take the postcode; removed the now-unused `ArrayList` import.
- `openapi.yml` — updated the `householdId` and `sharesHousehold` field descriptions to match the new semantics.

The `membershipLevel` had no household-size input in this codebase (it's email + namesake-based, per the spec's "level 4 reserved for tenure"), so no change was needed there.
